derivation: from the same as H3525 (כֶּבֶל) in the sense of limitation; sterile;
def: Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine

occurrences.text: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
